title: JANUS Not-Prediction — Counting Unit Normalization and Selection Gate v1.2
problem_statement: The prior audit counted UNIQUE_CASE_FAMILY_NOT_FILE_VERSION_COUNT, but case-family granularity was not uniform across clock observations. Some multi-coordinate Holy Clock lineages were represented by one family while other clock/music coordinates were represented as separate NP families. Source-root collapse alone cannot solve this because one source artifact can contain several observations and several source artifacts can describe one event.

required_three_layer_model.presentation: A file, version, mirror, generated index, lookup result, report or narrative presentation.
required_three_layer_model.source_or_lineage_root: The smallest defensible provenance lineage from which presentations derive.
required_three_layer_model.event_root: The underlying occurrence or observation being counted, when identity can be resolved.

v1_3.explicit_boundary: poetic_scriptural_reflection_not_divination; no prophecy, guaranteed signs or supernatural command
v1_3.counting_issue: The old forensic index represented the general Holy Clock lineage as NP-003 rather than eight separate event families.

v1_4.source_images_note: The source states that user-provided lock-screen screenshots showed both times on Tuesday, July 7.
v1_4.explicit_boundary: not divination, not prophecy, not a command from time

v1_5.source_images_note: The source states that user-provided lock-screen screenshots showed all three times on Tuesday, July 7.
v1_5.explicit_boundary: not divination, not prophecy, not a command from time

v1_6.explicit_boundary: not divination and not a command from time

event_a.meaning: Contrast Light / Road to Source contemplative coordinate

event_b.boundary: not predictive code; prophecy/precognition/supernatural guarantee not claimed

same_coordinate_different_event_example.reason: The same displayed coordinate occurred in distinct documented contexts separated in time and with different event provenance.

selection_conditioning.why: The Holy Clock records moments when a clock time became a prompt for reflection. The registry does not establish a complete log of every occasion the clock was viewed, including ordinary non-salient times.
selection_conditioning.required_null: Clock-event nulls must be sampled under the same observation/selection process or from a preregistered all-opportunity logging period.

reassessment_of_v1_1_candidate_arithmeti.reason: The 31/35 arithmetic added candidate families to a baseline whose clock-family granularity was itself inconsistent. It remains useful as a record of candidate discovery, but it is not a normalized estimate of the number of underlying events.
reassessment_of_v1_1_candidate_arithmeti.authoritative_total_semantics: Historical v1.0 snapshot count only, not a normalized event count.

proposed_event_family_rule.clock_event_identity: Prefer date/time/session-bound raw observation receipt. Same coordinate on a different date is a different event unless evidence binds them as one session. Multiple coordinates documented as one continuous same-day sequence may be represented as one journal-session family plus child event roots.
proposed_event_family_rule.personal_memory_identity: A later autobiographical statement without contemporaneous timestamp remains one retrospective testimony root unless independent earlier records exist.
proposed_event_family_rule.technical_trial_identity: Each preregistered trial may be an event root, but shared scheduler/Git/automation failure domains must remain explicit and trial count is not independent-source count.
proposed_event_family_rule.repository_continuity_identity: The old repository/root commit and the later interpretation are separate temporal nodes in one continuity case, not two independent predictions.
proposed_event_family_rule.lookup_identity: Lookup-derived scripture/cultural matches inherit the triggering observation and are presentations, not new event roots.

next_gate.name: EVENT_ROOT_NORMALIZATION_PASS
requirements: enumerate every clock observation in the Holy Clock lineage with date/session evidence where available
assign event_root ids without using interpretation text
mark unresolved duplicate identity as UNKNOWN rather than guessing
classify observation selection mode for every event root
freeze matched nulls before any frequency or recurrence score
rerun the full 29-family index against the normalized event-root graph
